species: Real recording of water drops falling and echoing inside the Ledyanaya cave near Staritsa, Russia, used for the glowworm (glowworms make no sound)
note: Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording; the recordist notes a limiter and light denoising were applied to the original. The 70 Hz high-pass removes measured low-frequency rumble.
